create_seq2seq_params: create a Seq2SeqParams instance to configure sequence-to-sequence model training with custom hyperparameters
configure_peft_lora: configure Seq2SeqParams to enable PEFT with LoRA parameters for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
set_training_hyperparameters: set learning rate, batch size, and epochs on Seq2SeqParams for seq2seq training
configure_early_stopping: configure early stopping patience and threshold on Seq2SeqParams to prevent overfitting
push_model_to_hub: configure Seq2SeqParams with push_to_hub and token to upload the trained model to Hugging Face Hub
